reviews.title: Premium $$ features now require a Pro Subscription $$$$
reviews.text: Blinq used to be a great app, and I was more than happy to pay for the premium version. Unfortunately, they decided to double the price without offering any real additional value. Charging twice as much for essentially the same features, including the ability to enrich contact information, is ridiculous. I understand companies need to make money, but doubling the cost while limiting features that customers previously enjoyed is a great way to lose loyal users. I’ll be looking for an alternative.

reviews.title: Great Card, but Solopreneurs are Blocked from Automation
reviews.text:
The actual digital business card, custom branding, and AI scanning features on Blinq Premium are great and work well. However, the plan structure is incredibly frustrating for solo business owners and independent professionals.

If you want to connect your card to Zapier, use webhooks, or automatically sync your newly scanned leads into your CRM (like GoHighLevel) to trigger follow-up drip automations, Blinq forces you to upgrade to their "Business" tier. The catch? The Business tier requires a 5-card minimum purchase.

Forcing a single operator to pay for 5 seats just to unlock a basic API token or Zapier connection makes no sense. Competitors like Popl offer CRM integrations on their individual Pro tiers for a fraction of the cost. If you are a solo entrepreneur looking to build an automated marketing pipeline, you are better off looking elsewhere until Blinq stops gating basic integrations behind corporate team pricing.

reviews.title: Lost All My Data Without Warning
reviews.text:
I had my business card fully set up with all my contact information and connections. Without any notice or explanation, the app deleted everything and is now forcing me to start from scratch. All my information is gone.
This is unacceptable for a professional networking tool. If you’re going to delete user data, at the very least provide advance warning or explain what happened. I’ve lost valuable time and connections because of this failure.
Until this is resolved and there’s assurance it won’t happen again, ✅ I cannot recommend this app to anyone who values their professional information.
